CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rpt_ConceptoIncluidoMembresia_Index]
@EntityId AS INT = 0, 
@Membresia_Id AS INT = 0, 
@ConceptoFacturable_Id AS INT = 0
AS
BEGIN
	
	-- IMPORTANT:
	-- This is a computer generated procedure.  DO NOT ADD CUSTOM CODE TO THIS PROCEDURE.

	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	
	-- 1) CREATE FILTER TABLE:
	DECLARE @ConceptoIncluidoMembresiaFilter TABLE (
		Id INT IDENTITY (1,1),
		ConceptoIncluidoMembresia_Id INT		
	)


    -- IF A GIVEN ID HAS BEEN SPECIFIED, THEN RETRIEVE THAT RECORD ONLY
	IF @EntityId <> 0
	BEGIN

		INSERT INTO @ConceptoIncluidoMembresiaFilter (ConceptoIncluidoMembresia_Id)
		SELECT 
			[ConceptoIncluidoMembresia].Id
		FROM [dbo].[ConceptoIncluidoMembresia]
		WHERE
			 [dbo].[ConceptoIncluidoMembresia].[Id] = @EntityId

	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN

		-- 2) FILTER BY FOREIGN RELATIONSHIPS WHEN APLICABLE:
		INSERT INTO @ConceptoIncluidoMembresiaFilter (ConceptoIncluidoMembresia_Id)
		SELECT 
			[ConceptoIncluidoMembresia].Id
		FROM [dbo].[ConceptoIncluidoMembresia]
		WHERE
			 [ConceptoIncluidoMembresia].[Activo] = 1 AND
         (([ConceptoIncluidoMembresia].[Membresia_Id] = @Membresia_Id) OR (@Membresia_Id = 0)) AND
         (([ConceptoIncluidoMembresia].[ConceptoFacturable_Id] = @ConceptoFacturable_Id) OR (@ConceptoFacturable_Id = 0))

 	END

 
	-- 4) DELIVER THE FILTERED RESULTS:
	SELECT 
		[ConceptoIncluidoMembresia].[Id],
		[ConceptoFacturable].[Concepto] AS [ConceptoFacturableConcepto],
		[ConceptoFacturable].[Descripcion] AS [ConceptoFacturableDescripcion],
		[ConceptoIncluidoMembresia].[Cantidad],
		[ConceptoFacturable].[PrecioUnitario],
		CONVERT(varchar, CAST(([ConceptoFacturable].[PrecioUnitario] * [ConceptoIncluidoMembresia].[Cantidad]) AS money), 1) as MontoTotal,
		[ConceptoIncluidoMembresia].[IncluidoEnLaMembresia],
		[ConceptoIncluidoMembresia].[Activo],
		[ConceptoIncluidoMembresia].[FechaDesactivacion],
		[ConceptoIncluidoMembresia].[DesactivadoPor],
		[ConceptoIncluidoMembresia].[FechaCreacion],
		[ConceptoIncluidoMembresia].[CreadoPor],
		[ConceptoIncluidoMembresia].[FechaModificacion],
		[ConceptoIncluidoMembresia].[ModificadoPor]
	FROM @ConceptoIncluidoMembresiaFilter filter
		JOIN [dbo].[ConceptoIncluidoMembresia] 
			ON [ConceptoIncluidoMembresia].[Id] = filter.[ConceptoIncluidoMembresia_Id] 

		LEFT JOIN [dbo].[Membresia]
		ON [dbo].[ConceptoIncluidoMembresia].[Membresia_Id] = [dbo].[Membresia].[Id] 

 		LEFT JOIN [dbo].[ConceptoFacturable]
		ON [dbo].[ConceptoIncluidoMembresia].[ConceptoFacturable_Id] = [dbo].[ConceptoFacturable].[Id] 


END
